title: AgentOffer Supply Offer Profile Registry v1.0
description: Closed registry for stable v1.0 supply Offer profiles. Generic Offers omit offer_info.details; registered profiles carry their domain facts only in details.data.

supplyDetails.description: Closed supply-profile envelope. profile selects exactly one registered closed data shape.

profile.description: Registered supply Offer profile identifier in the stable v1.0 registry.

data.description: Closed domain facts for the selected registered profile.

flightData.description: Closed public facts for one priced air itinerary and its traveller composition.

trip_type.description: Declared itinerary topology; semantic validation binds it to the number of legs.

travelers.description: Non-empty traveller counts grouped by traveller type. Each type may occur at most once under semantic validation.

legs.description: Ordered itinerary legs. Each leg contains one or more ordered flight segments.

price_basis.description: Price nature: a reference amount without traveler composition or a complete itinerary total.

fare_details.description: Optional facts tied to this exact traveler-composed itinerary quote; invalid for a reference price.

emissions.description: Optional estimated total itinerary emissions with model provenance, never an operationally measured amount.

traveler.description: Traveler counts and optional age and infant seat facts; typed quotes require sufficient age and seat information.

type.description: Traveller type used to state the priced traveller composition.

count.description: Positive number of travellers of this type included in the stated itinerary price.

ages.description: Completed years of age on the first local departure date, in traveler order.

infant_seat_required.description: Seat requirement for each infant at the same index as ages.

flightLeg.description: One ordered flight leg made up of one or more contiguous flight segments.

segments.description: Ordered segments for this leg. Semantic validation requires adjacent arrival and departure continuity.

duration_minutes.description: Source-provided total leg duration including connection waiting, at least the sum of segment durations.

connections.description: Optional ordered details of each boundary between adjacent segments; if present, one item per boundary. An airport change requires this array and an explicit matching airport_change=true.

flightSegment.description: Closed public facts for one marketed flight segment.

departure.description: Scheduled departure airport and airport-local date-time for this segment.

arrival.description: Scheduled arrival airport and airport-local date-time for this segment.

duration_minutes.description: Positive source-provided scheduled elapsed duration of this segment in minutes. It is authoritative for duration; producers must not infer a timezone to derive it from local_at values.

marketing_carrier.description: Carrier marketing this flight under the displayed flight number.

code.description: Two-character uppercase marketing carrier code; registry membership is not asserted by this profile.

name.description: Source-provided display name in the Offer content language; must contain a character outside Unicode White_Space plus U+FEFF. Omit when unavailable; never infer from codes. Name of the marketing carrier, not operating carrier or booking platform.

logo_url.description: Absolute HTTPS carrier-logo URL without userinfo; omit when display rights or a stable asset URL are unavailable.

flight_number.description: Carrier-local flight number without the marketing-carrier prefix.

cabin_class.description: Public cabin class for this segment.

stops.description: Source-reported stops within this segment. Omission means unknown; an empty array explicitly means no stops.

planned_aircraft.description: Supplier-reported planned aircraft name, not a standardized aircraft type or actual operating equipment.

operating_carrier.description: Verified operating carrier for this scheduled segment; omit when operating identity is unknown.

name.description: Optional source-reported operating carrier name with explicit language.

logo_url.description: Absolute HTTPS carrier-logo URL without userinfo; omit when display rights or a stable asset URL are unavailable.

operating_flight_number.description: Verified operating-carrier-local flight number; requires operating_carrier. Omit if only a marketing or codeshare number is known.

standard_aircraft_type.description: Verified standardized scheduled aircraft type; distinct from source-reported planned_aircraft and subject to equipment changes.

cabin_amenities.description: Verified amenities for this scheduled segment and cabin class; omission means unknown. Availability can change with equipment.

flightEndpoint.description: Airport and airport-local scheduled date-time at one end of a flight segment.

airport_code.description: Three-letter uppercase airport code; airport-registry membership is outside this profile.

local_at.description: Scheduled local date-time at this airport in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss form, without a UTC offset or timezone. Producers normalize a source space separator to T and must not infer missing timezone data.

city_code.description: Optional city code, distinct from airport_code. Does not establish trusted airport-to-city membership.

city_name.description: Source-provided display name in the Offer content language; must contain a character outside Unicode White_Space plus U+FEFF. Omit when unavailable; never infer from codes. City name, not airport name.

airport_full_name.description: Source-reported full airport name at this endpoint, independent of the Offer content language.

terminal.description: Source-reported terminal at this endpoint; omit when absent or blank.

timezone.description: Verified IANA time zone identifier for this airport. Local_at remains an offset-free source schedule.

gameData.description: Closed public facts for a game Offer. It is descriptive content supplied with the Offer, not an AON endorsement or ranking signal.

downloads.description: Source-reported cumulative download or install count for the game. When the source publishes a range or threshold such as 1M+, use its lower bound (1000000); never round up or estimate.

hotelRateData.description: Closed public facts for a hotel reference starting nightly price. This profile never asserts a confirmed inventory allocation or total-stay price.

rate.description: Closed price-nature declaration for the hotel rate profile.

kind.description: The price is a source-observed single-night reference or starting price, not a booking, inventory, room-allocation, or total-stay assertion.

property.description: Identified hotel property and its public location facts.

location.description: Public AON location reference, country, and optional source-provided display facts for the property.

property_type.description: Optional source-provided property type when known.

star_rating.description: Optional source-provided property star rating when known. String values preserve existing source formatting; numeric values must be from 1 through 5.

stay.description: Optional stay facts. Omit the entire object when dates are unknown; when supplied both dates are required.

check_in.description: Known local check-in calendar date; never a default or inferred placeholder.

check_out.description: Known local check-out calendar date; semantic validation requires it to be after check_in.

occupancy.description: Optional known search or booking occupancy. Omit it instead of inventing room or guest counts.

room.description: Optional room facts. Omit the entire object when the room type is unknown.

name.description: Non-empty source-provided room name when the room is known.

room_id.description: Optional opaque source room identifier when it is safe to disclose.

max_occupancy.description: Optional maximum room occupancy when known.

room_type_guaranteed.description: Optional source assertion that the named room type is guaranteed.

hotelLocation.description: Public hotel-property location. location_id is an AON Full Location Catalog v1 string identifier checked semantically; country_code is independently supplied rather than inferred. Source display facts remain nested under location to match existing supply adapters.

location_id.description: Numeric-string identifier that must be an active AON Full Location Catalog v1 member under semantic validation.

country_code.description: Uppercase two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country or territory code supplied by the source.

city.description: Optional source-provided city display name when known.

address.description: Optional source-provided property address when known.

latitude.description: Optional WGS-84 latitude when supplied by the source. String values preserve existing adapter payloads; numeric values must be from -90 through 90.

longitude.description: Optional WGS-84 longitude when supplied by the source. String values preserve existing adapter payloads; numeric values must be from -180 through 180.

timezone.description: Optional source-provided IANA-style property timezone when known.

hotelOccupancy.description: Known aggregate occupancy for a hotel stay. It does not imply a per-room allocation.

rooms.description: Positive number of rooms when known.

adults.description: Positive number of adult guests when known.

children_ages.description: Optional ages of known child guests. Omit when there are no children or their ages are unknown.

flightSourceText.description: Untranslated source text with an explicit source-language state.

text.description: Nonblank source-reported display text, preserved without translation or normalization into the Offer content language.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for the source text; und indicates that the source language is unverified.

flightPlannedAircraft.description: Supplier-reported planned aircraft label and its provenance; it is not a standardized type or actual operating equipment.

name.description: Source-reported aircraft model label with the source language recorded.

source.description: Identifies the supplier as the source of this planned aircraft label.

flightStop.description: A source-reported stop with a location label or airport code.

name.description: Source-provided nonblank location label, which may identify a city rather than an airport.

name_language.description: Language of the source-provided stop name; und means unverified. Requires name.

airport_code.description: Source-provided uppercase airport code; do not infer it from a location name.

duration_minutes.description: Positive source-provided stop duration in minutes.

flightConnection.description: Connection from segment at after_segment_index to the next segment in the same leg.

after_segment_index.description: Zero-based index of the segment before this connection.

airport_change.description: True exactly when arrival and following departure airport codes differ.

duration_minutes.description: Verified elapsed time from first arrival to next departure, including a known airport transfer when applicable.

flightCabinAmenities.description: Observed or provider-confirmed facilities for the particular flight and cabin. False is an affirmative absence; omit unknown fields.

wifi.description: Confirmed Wi-Fi availability in this segment and cabin.

power_outlet.description: Confirmed in-seat power availability in this segment and cabin.

inflight_entertainment.description: Confirmed in-flight entertainment availability in this segment and cabin.

meal_included.description: Whether a meal is included for this segment and cabin.

seat_pitch_inches.description: Verified seat pitch in inches for this cabin configuration.

amount.description: Non-negative quoted monetary amount in the stated currency.

currency.description: Uppercase three-letter currency code for the quoted amount.

flightBaggageAllowance.description: Included allowance from the same fare quote; zero pieces explicitly means none.

pieces.description: Number of baggage pieces included in this fare component; zero means none.

total_weight_kg.description: Total included baggage weight in kilograms.

max_weight_kg_per_piece.description: Maximum included weight in kilograms for each piece.

flightFarePolicy.description: Fare-specific conditions from the quoted seller; exact applicability remains in the summary.

permitted.description: Whether the quoted fare permits this change or refund under the stated conditions.

fee.description: Exact quoted fee only when the summary states its applicable conditions.

flightSeatSelection.description: Seat selection terms for this fare component, not generic aircraft seat availability.

included.description: Whether seat selection is included in this fare component.

starting_fee.description: Source-quoted starting seat-selection fee, not a selected seat or final charge.

flightFareComponent.description: Fare facts applying to one traveler type on one segment of this priced itinerary.

leg_index.description: Zero-based leg index for this quoted fare component.

segment_index.description: Zero-based segment index within the referenced leg.

traveler_type.description: Quoted traveler type to which these fare rights apply.

booking_class.description: Source-confirmed reservation booking class for this segment and traveler type.

flightFareDetails.description: Terms of the same seller quote as commercial.price, not an airline-wide default. Omit unknown facts.

components.description: Fare rights by quoted traveler type and itinerary segment.

self_transfer.description: Seller-confirmed self-transfer status of this quoted itinerary.

separate_tickets.description: Seller-confirmed separate-ticket status of this quoted itinerary.

baggage_recheck_required.description: Seller-confirmed baggage recheck requirement for this quoted itinerary.

flightEmissions.description: Estimated whole-itinerary climate impact, not an observed flight status or guaranteed actual emissions.

estimated_kg_co2e.description: Estimated whole-itinerary carbon dioxide equivalent in kilograms.

relative_to_typical_percent.description: Signed comparison with a comparable-route typical flight: negative means lower estimated emissions.

methodology.description: Name or version of the method used to estimate emissions.

calculated_at.description: Timestamp at which the emissions estimate was calculated.
